items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: He said, would you come over and show me some day? I said, Tommy, you never sounded better... But he said, he taught and he wanted to find out about it and everything.

ctx.x: Tommy was very impressed with my chops. He said, man -- you know, he kept raving about my range and endurance and my age and everything. And I told him about my system and everything and he said he had false teeth. And he said, would you come over and show me some day? I said, Tommy, you never sounded better. You don't need any help. You sound better than you ever sounded and better than anybody else." But he said, he taught and he wanted to find out about it and everything.

I didn't know how well it would work on a trombone because it involves being able to push the valves down with one hand while you hold the mouthpiece with the other. And it would be hard on the trombone to get different positions.
